0022600036.text: The Cleveland Cavaliers (6-6, 6th in the East) visit the Miami Heat (5-6, 8th in the East) in an Emirates NBA Cup East Group B game, the 13th of the season for Cleveland. Cleveland enters on a one-game winning streak with a 2-4 road record, while Miami has won two straight but is 1-3 at home. Sam Merrill is out for the Cavaliers with an elbow injury, and the Heat's Klay Thompson (ankle) and Pelle Larsson (illness) are both day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and Cleveland won the last meeting 149-128 in Cleveland on March 27, 2026.
